_note: THIS factory's recorded law-version decouplings — permanent debt, not forgiveness. Each entry is a commit whose law-file BODY moved while its `version:` stayed, which leaves that version naming two different bodies forever: a lane holding it cannot tell which bytes it has. The law forbids backfilling a bump ('a bump written after the fact would be a falsified record rather than a repair'), and a bump-only commit would violate the contract's second arm, so the repair space is genuinely empty. These print as `excused:` lines on every run. Skeleton and field rules: docs/skill-version-exemptions.example.json.
